name: Nandi Valley Neuro, Spine & Multispeciality Hospital
description: A neuroscience-led hospital with a comprehensive epilepsy programme, movement-disorder clinic, scoliosis and complex spine unit and a radiosurgery centre, supported by orthopaedics, oncology and fertility departments.
